I cancelled my Digitech Trio pre-order with Sweetwater

I finally got a chance to spend some quality time with my Trio. Ultimately, I don't love it. The first thing about it is that it's unpredictable. It is like a roll of the dice. You don't know if your rhythm section will be on meth, valium, or be totally on and just nail the groove. It would also be handy to be able to store your groove, because it never does the same thing twice.

In regards to operation, I really don't understand why on the three button outboard footswitch, the first button has the exact same function as the one on the device itself. That really seems like a waste of a button to me.

The biggest issue for me, however, is that it really needs a looper built in. It doesn't even need a complicated looper, it just needs to be able to record and play back the parts you play into it during the learn mode. I've tried running it in serial with my Boss RC-30 looper, and it does wonky things with the timing. Part of that may be that there is a slight delay from the moment you press the button to end learn mode and the actual start of the groove. The end result is that it's just about impossible to sync it with an outboard looper. I would not be surprised to see a deluxe model down the road with a built in looper and storage memory. That would be the product of the century.

Hello, hello and welcome all you magnificent dudes, dudettes, and other assorted carbon-based-lifeforms. I know what your'e all thinking, your'e all probably thinking of me as a jumper of bandwagons, a fairweather follower, a netizen of mercenary interest. But you misjudge me, you liberated few. I would never place myself in the position of the cad who latches on to some shiny new bauble, only to abandon it with scorn the moment it falls from the gimlet eye of the unwashed masses.

I am of an altogether different philosophy. A philosophy that dictates that the true wonders of this global information sea that we refer to as the internet come from a minority opinion allowing itself into the stark light of wide attention with but a warm look in its eyes and hope in its heart. A philosophy that dictates that the only universal truth on this pale blue spit of a sublime cosmos is that no ideology or creed should bar any individual from access to the essential fervor of reasoned discourse. A philosophy that drove me away from a website on which I had lurked so dutifully, which had in my sight become a den of false messiahs and craven robber-barons hiding behind the soiled standard of Progressiveness.

To be truthful, I still keep one foot in my former homeland. For although this kingdom displays the potential to become a thing of true beauty, my attentions still find themselves drawn to those hubs of discussion which in this fair kingdom find themselves not so populated. But if there is one thing that I am drawn to in this place, it is the supreme quality of the speaking that goes on here. Reddit, though it has given me many treasured memories of laughter, of awe, of disgust, has in its time succumbed to the decadence of the masses and summoned forth the foul demon of shitposting, and is in my eyes a ship on its last tattered remains of its once-proud sails. You, Voat, are still young, with the shining gem of promise in your brow that in and of itself outweighs all the crass wealth of this world.

Regardless, I see your patience waning. Perhaps you have duties of a scholarly nature to attend to. Perhaps there are matters of family that draw you away from the crystal mirror of your screen. Perhaps the call of Mother Night is making itself intimately present on your wakeful brow, for you are casting your eyes upon this fair screed as they themselves become increasingly burdened with the adamant weights of exhaustion. It is for your sake, and your sake alone, that I shall draw my ramblings to a well-needed close.

So in the sureness of the conclusion we find ourselves in, I would merely like to say that I look forward to a long relationship with this blessed site. For though your users are few, you display a promise and brilliance that has been rare in my sight over the course of my existence as one of those maligned digital natives. And should this brilliant website grow, vaster than empires, and more slow, you shall find me happily among you storied few.

You may welcome me to Voat now. And if I can summon the audacity to finally conclude this undoubtedly poncey scrawl, it is to say that this post here is hopefully but the very first step in a long and wondrous odyssey. Dare I say it? This could be the beginning of a beautiful friendship.
